new_with_range.brief: Creates a new `GtkSpinButton` with the given properties.
new_with_range.md:
Creates a new `GtkSpinButton` with the given properties.

This is a convenience constructor that allows creation
of a numeric `GtkSpinButton` without manually creating
an adjustment. The value is initially set to the minimum
value and a page increment of 10 * `step` is the default.
The precision of the spin button is equivalent to the
precision of `step`.

Note that the way in which the precision is derived works
best if `step` is a power of ten. If the resulting precision
is not suitable for your needs, use
[`SpinButton.set_digits()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SpinButton#method:set_digits) to correct it.

configure.md:

set_activates_default.md:

widget for the window containing the spin button.

See [`SpinButton::activate`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SpinButton#event:activate) for what counts as activation.

set_climb_rate.brief: Sets the acceleration rate for repeated changes when you hold down a button or key.
set_climb_rate.md:
Sets the acceleration rate for repeated changes when you

set_digits.md:
Set the precision to be displayed by `spin_button`.

Up to 20 digit precision is allowed.

set_increments.md:
Sets the step and page increments for spin_button.

This affects how quickly the value changes when
the spin button’s arrows are activated.

set_numeric.brief: Sets the flag that determines if non-numeric text can be typed into the spin button.
set_numeric.md:
Sets the flag that determines if non-numeric text can be typed
into the spin button.

set_range.brief: Sets the minimum and maximum allowable values for `spin_button`.
set_range.md:
Sets the minimum and maximum allowable values for `spin_button`.

If the current value is outside this range, it will be adjusted
to fit within the range, otherwise it will remain unchanged.

set_snap_to_ticks.brief: Sets the policy as to whether values are corrected to the nearest step increment when a spin button is activated after providing an invalid value.
set_snap_to_ticks.md:

nearest step increment when a spin button is activated after
providing an invalid value.

set_update_policy.md:
Sets the update behavior of a spin button.

This determines whether the spin button is always
updated or only when a valid value is set.

set_wrap.brief: Sets the flag that determines if a spin button value wraps around to the opposite limit when the upper or lower limit of the range is exceeded.
set_wrap.md:

around to the opposite limit when the upper or lower limit
of the range is exceeded.

climb-rate.md: The acceleration rate when you hold down a button or key.

wrap.md: Whether a spin button should wrap upon reaching its limits.

activate.brief: Emitted when the spin button is activated.
activate.md:
Emitted when the spin button is activated.

The keybindings for this signal are all forms of the <kbd>Enter</kbd> key.

If the <kbd>Enter</kbd> key results in the value being committed to the
spin button, then activation does not occur until <kbd>Enter</kbd> is
pressed again.

change-value.brief: Emitted when the user initiates a value change.
change-value.md:
Emitted when the user initiates a value change.

This is a [keybinding signal](class.SignalAction.html).

Applications should not connect to it, but may emit it with
g_signal_emit_by_name() if they need to control the cursor
programmatically.

The default bindings for this signal are Up/Down and PageUp/PageDown.

input.brief: Emitted to convert the users input into a double value.
input.md:
Emitted to convert the users input into a double value.

The signal handler is expected to use [`Editable.get_text()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Editable#method:get_text)
to retrieve the text of the spinbutton and set `new_value` to the
new value.

The default conversion uses g_strtod().

output.brief: Emitted to tweak the formatting of the value for display.

value-changed.brief: Emitted when the value is changed.
value-changed.md:
Emitted when the value is changed.

Also see the [`SpinButton::output`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SpinButton#event:output) signal.

wrapped.brief: Emitted right after the spinbutton wraps from its maximum to its minimum value or vice-versa.
wrapped.md:
Emitted right after the spinbutton wraps from its maximum
to its minimum value or vice-versa.
